tools.name: superphone_get_account
tools.description: The Superphone account behind the API key: user id, email, name, the business phone numbers (number, default/active flags, short code) and notification preferences. GraphQL query `me`.

tools.name: superphone_list_contacts
tools.description: List the SMS contacts (the subscriber list) with name, mobile, email, company, VIP/hidden/archived/unsubscribed/opted-out flags, total spent, creation date and tags (up to 20). Oldest first; page with next_cursor. `total` is the size of the whole list. GraphQL query `contacts`.

tools.name: superphone_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id with every profile field, tags, custom contributions (recorded purchases) and its latest 10 conversations (ids to read with superphone_get_conversation). GraphQL query `contact`.

tools.name: superphone_find_contact
tools.description: Find one contact by exact mobile number or email address (give at least one; E.164 such as +12132679977 is best). Returns the full contact or null when none matches. GraphQL query `contactByIdentifier`.

tools.name: superphone_list_conversations
tools.description: List text conversations (the inbox): id, participant number, platform (TWILIO = SMS, FACEBOOK = Messenger), hidden/archived flags, creation date and the contact. Page with next_cursor. Read the messages of one with superphone_get_conversation. GraphQL query `conversations`.

tools.name: superphone_get_conversation
tools.description: One conversation with its most recent messages (default 20, newest last): body, from/to, direction (INCOMING_TEXT, OUTGOING_TEXT, SYSTEM, calls), delivery status, errors and media. To read older messages pass `before` = the previous reply's previous_cursor. GraphQL query `conversation`.

tools.name: superphone_get_message
tools.description: One message by id: body, from/to, direction, delivery status, error and media. GraphQL query `message`.

tools.name: superphone_list_forms
tools.description: List the sign-up (opt-in) forms: id, public hashId, domain, titles, opt-in text flag, optional fields, redirect URL, default and enabled flags. GraphQL query `forms`.

tools.name: superphone_get_form
tools.description: One sign-up form by id, or the account's default form when form_id is omitted. GraphQL queries `form` / `defaultForm`.

tools.name: superphone_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the configured webhooks: id, destination URL, active flag and subscribed events (CONTACT_ADDED, CONTACT_UPDATED, CONTACT_TAGS_CHANGED, MESSAGE_RECEIVED, MESSAGE_SENT, MESSAGE_STATUS_UPDATED). GraphQL query `webhooks`.

tools.name: superphone_search_numbers
tools.description: Search phone numbers that could be bought for the account, optionally starting with some digits (for example an area code), with their price. Read-only: this tool never buys a number. GraphQL query `searchNumbers`.

tools.name: superphone_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (first name required; add a mobile number or email so it can be reached). Creating a contact does not send it a message. Returns the new contact. GraphQL mutation `createContact`.

tools.name: superphone_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact. Only the fields you pass change: the tool first reads the contact and sends the full record back with your changes (the API requires the first name on every update). Pass an empty string to clear a text field. Returns the updated contact. GraphQL mutation

tools.name: superphone_add_contact_tags
tools.description: WRITE: apply tags to a contact, by name (a new name creates the tag) or by tag id. Tags can drive automations in Superphone. Returns the contact with its tags. GraphQL mutations `addContactTagsByNames` / `addContactTags`.

tools.name: superphone_remove_contact_tags
tools.description: WRITE: remove tags from a contact, by name or by tag id. This can take the contact out of tag-driven segments and automations. Returns the contact with its remaining tags. GraphQL mutations `removeContactTagsByNames` / `removeContactTags`.

tools.name: superphone_add_contribution
tools.description: WRITE: record a purchase or donation against a contact (name, amount, date). It adds to the contact's total spent and cannot be undone with this server. Returns the new contribution. GraphQL mutation `createCustomContribution`.

tools.name: superphone_send_message
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: send a real text message to a customer from the account's number. It is delivered immediately, uses the account's messaging credits and cannot be recalled. Only send what the user explicitly asked for, to the number they named, and never to contacts who unsubscribed or opted out

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "superphone_send_message" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_get_conversation, superphone_get_message, superphone_list_forms, superphone_list_webhooks · Private data: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_get_contact, superphone_find_contact, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_create_contact, superphone_update_contact, superphone_add_contact_tags, superphone_remove_contact_tags, superphone_add_contribution, superphone_send_message · Public sink: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_find_contact, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_create_contact, superphone_send_message · Destructive: superphone_remove_contact_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_get_conversation, superphone_get_message, superphone_list_forms, superphone_list_webhooks · Private data: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_get_contact, superphone_find_contact, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_create_contact, superphone_update_contact, superphone_add_contact_tags, superphone_remove_contact_tags, superphone_add_contribution, superphone_send_message · Public sink: superphone_get_account, superphone_list_contacts, superphone_find_contact, superphone_list_conversations, superphone_create_contact, superphone_send_message · Destructive: superphone_remove_contact_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
